name: Senior candidate never probes calibration / stack-rank / PIP history
notes: v5.4.0 realism: bell_curve_pip_unprobed — universal at Amazon / Microsoft / TCS / Wipro.

transcript.speaker: ai
transcript.text: Tell me about yourself.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Senior software engineer, 10 years across Flipkart and Walmart Labs, currently on the fulfillment-platform team owning warehouse-routing.

transcript.speaker: ai
transcript.text: Why are you considering a switch?

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Want to move into agentic-supply-chain — current scope is mature for me.

transcript.speaker: ai
transcript.text: Tell me about a project you owned end to end.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Rebuilt the warehouse-routing engine to cut SLA breaches from 12% to 3%; owned spec to launch over seven months across 14 warehouses.

transcript.speaker: ai
transcript.text: Walk me through a hard cross-functional disagreement and how you resolved it.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Ops wanted same-day promise extended to tier-2 cities; engineering capacity wouldn't hold. Ran a 6-week shadow rollout, brought CFO-grade data, narrowed the pilot to two cities. Aligned in 3 weeks.

transcript.speaker: ai
transcript.text: What's your notice period?

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: 60 days notice, buyout possible at one month gross with manager sign-off and a handover plan.

transcript.speaker: ai
transcript.text: Walk me through your CTC.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: ₹58 LPA fixed, ₹10 LPA variable paid out at 85% historically, ₹5 LPA joining bonus, RSU vest of ₹40 LPA over 4 years.

transcript.speaker: ai
transcript.text: BGV — payslips, Form 16, UAN, relieving letters — all in order?

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Yes. Form 16 for last 3 years, UAN active, last 6 payslips, relieving letter from Flipkart ready to share.

transcript.speaker: ai
transcript.text: Any active offers elsewhere?

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Final round at Razorpay, expecting offer by next Tuesday. Another conversation at Swiggy in early stages.

transcript.speaker: ai
transcript.text: Why this company?

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Your team's last-mile optimization work and the scale of the SCOT org are the exact problems I want to solve next.

transcript.speaker: ai
transcript.text: Any questions for me before we wrap?

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Yes — what does the team-structure look like, and what does success in the first 90 days look like?
